output.summary: Prefer project-local CodeWiki installs and guard mutation.

approvedRows.question: DTR-project-local-install-policy
approvedRows.currentState: CodeWiki package use was validated externally, but docs and mutation tools did not yet make project-local Pi installation the default safety boundary.
approvedRows.desiredState: Docs recommend pi install -l npm:codewiki and mutation-capable commands/tools refuse non-project package installs unless explicitly overridden for controlled tests.
approvedRows.rationale: CodeWiki state belongs to the repository being documented; global installs are too easy to aim at the wrong project.
approvedRows.userImpact: Improves user outcomes by preserving clear project intent.
approvedRows.maintainerImpact: Keeps implementation cost bounded and reviewable.
approvedRows.recommendationRationale: Evidence supports this intention as valuable and safe to plan.

agentAssessment.userAlignment: Matches the user's stated goal and assumes good-faith project intent.
agentAssessment.projectBenefit: Improves CodeWiki while preserving trace-backed source truth.
agentAssessment.rationale: No lower-cost alternative better serves the user and project.

approvedRows.safetyBoundary: Mutation must run from a project-local CodeWiki Pi package or an explicit controlled-test override.
failureModes: User installs CodeWiki globally and mutates the wrong repository.
Package smoke imports CodeWiki outside a project-local Pi cache without explicit override.
Docs imply CodeWiki provides sandboxing instead of being sandbox-compatible.
approvedRows.negativeTestPlan: Unit-test install-scope detection and run existing package dogfood with explicit controlled-test overrides.
approvedRows.compatibilityImpact: Read-only state remains available; mutation adds a project-local install guard and controlled-test override.
approvedRows.currentPain: The current behavior leaves project intent less structured than it could be.
approvedRows.desiredOutcome: The decision creates a clearer, more useful project outcome.
approvedRows.successSignal: Planning can consume the decision without additional intent clarification.
nonGoals: Do not expand scope beyond the approved decision row.

workItems.title: Add project-local install policy and mutation guard

Update package dogfood tests and readiness coverage.
